row.body:
Sunday after supper: two workers from the greenhouse trial carried a bitter residue. my hands blistered before the phones went dead.

They counted the containers before anyone counted who had carried them. I wrote the second number here while I could still remember it.

The amount mattered to the office more than the people waiting outside. We stayed until dark because the last line still said to wait.

row.body:
We put the guests names on a sheet so we could keep the surprise. A stranger arrived with a copy that had two names removed.

He asked whether those two had already left. I said one was still upstairs, getting ready. He folded his copy and waited at the foot of the stairs.

Nobody wanted to spoil the party by arguing. I have kept our list because it is the only one with everyone on it.
row.title: The list for the party
